'''Dan Aykroyd''' was a famous actor within the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Although he shared a similar name with [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]' PR [[Droid/Legends|droid]] announcer, [[Dan Android]], any relation between the two is unclear.<ref name="CGtST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dan Aykroyd was briefly mentioned in the "Spot the Droid" poster's bio for Dan Android as well as the ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'', jokingly mentioning the similarities between the names, in the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']].<ref name="CGtST" />
